description.value: Wasan Cafe is a Chinese fast-food café occupying a commercial unit in Richmond's Odlin Crescent area. It serves Chinese cuisine and maintains an active Instagram presence. The Richmond area has a dense cycling network and many cyclists pass through this commercial corridor.
